person: World Health Organization and United Nations
promise: Reach 70% COVID-19 vaccination coverage in every country by mid-2022.
description: The joint October 7, 2021 strategy set a country-by-country vaccination target. WHO reported in July 2022 that average country coverage was about 60%, so the universal 70% goal was not achieved despite substantial progress.
evidence: The October 7 strategy establishes the target and date.
WHO's July 22, 2022 update reports average country coverage of about 60%, below the universal 70% objective.
